title: Claimwake
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Claimwake and the helm marks Dead Hollow. Do: Close on Dead Hollow. Dead homesteads. Reclaim is the pocket on the claim slate. Strip is the other choice. The law is red. Finish: come inside Dead Hollow's shell. Red Keel heat rises. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
